#### 1. autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 70  —  Tier 2 — Strong / Probable  (fitness 0.737)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:6898)

**Proposed mechanism:** Loss-of-function variants in MARS1 —DISRUPTS→ Methionyl-tRNA synthetase 1 (HGNC:6898); Methionyl-tRNA synthetase 1 (HGNC:6898) —DISRUPTS→ tRNA charging with methionine (GO:0006413); tRNA charging with methionine (GO:0006413) —DECREASES→ Protein synthesis (GO:0006412); Protein synthesis (GO:0006412) —DECREASES→ Neuronal function (GO:0007264); Neuronal function (GO:0007264) —LEADS_TO→ Spastic paraplegia (HP:0001257); Neuronal function (GO:0007264) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). Loss-of-function mutations in MARS1 impair tRNA charging with methionine, which in turn disrupts global protein synthesis. This deficiency severely impacts neuronal function, leading to the spastic paraplegia and intellectual disability phenotypes observed in both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** The discovery of pathogenic variants in MARS1 associated with gain-of-function mechanisms or completely distinct pathways for each disease would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs749211808)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism of MARS1 dysfunction in both diseases could lead to the development of therapies targeting protein synthesis or neuronal support pathways, benefiting patients with either condition.
